source_review.exact_scope_sentence: You can upload your translations for any mods you want.
source_review.exact_endorsement_sentence: Not endorsed and not related to Vanilla Expanded in any way.
source_review.summary: The reply says independent translations are the translator's own submissions, leaves the disclosed use of AI to the translator, and explicitly permits uploads beyond the originally named list. It does not endorse the submitted translations.

application_interpretation: The broader sentence supports additional independently authored text-only supplements for original Vanilla Expanded works that credit Oskar and share the verified publisher of the explicitly covered Vanilla Expanded Framework. This is a deliberately narrower application than the literal phrase 'any mods'; it does not grant permissions on behalf of unrelated original authors or community translators.
original_request_scope_retained: Free standalone Russian language patches requiring the original mod.
Original author and source links retained.
Own typographic covers; no original images, DLLs, textures or unrelated original assets distributed.
No third-party Russian wording included under this permission.
AI assistance disclosed; no Vanilla Expanded endorsement or independent human-review claim.
Source, duplicate-translation and game QA remain separate release requirements.
